description: This source file provides an implementation of POSIX threading (pthreads) for Windows, specifically targeting Git's subset of the API. It includes thread creation, joining, self-identification, and condition wait functionalities tailored for Windows via Win32 API calls.

methods.name: unsigned __stdcall win32_start_routine(void * arg)
methods.description: Thread entry point for executing the start routine within a new Windows thread; updates the thread ID and argument after execution.

methods.name: int pthread_create(pthread_t * thread,const void * attr UNUSED,void * (* start_routine)(void *),void * arg)
methods.description: Creates a new thread executing the given start routine with the provided argument, returning error code or success.

methods.name: int win32_pthread_join(pthread_t * thread,void ** value_ptr)
methods.description: Waits for a thread to finish execution and retrieves its return value, cleaning up the thread handle afterward.

methods.name: pthread_t pthread_self(void)
methods.description: Returns a pthread_t structure representing the current thread.

methods.name: int pthread_cond_wait(pthread_cond_t * cond,pthread_mutex_t * mutex)
methods.description: Blocks the current thread until the specified condition variable is signaled, using a mutex for synchronization.
